Part 1: https://youtu.be/xq9iv5h0X0o
--------
In this VladTV interview, Ossi Ketola explains how a 2024 “side quest” into live poker quickly became a high-stakes public spectacle. Ketola discusses entering Triton Poker tournaments as an amateur, cashing in 7 of 11 events, nearly winning a $150,000 buy-in tournament, and taking home around $4 million after finishing second to a 69-year-old Estonian player.

The conversation then turns to Ketola’s heads-up poker matches, including games against Jungleman and escalating buy-ins that reportedly reached about $63 million total. He breaks down a $20 million pot, a 40-hour stretch tied to a $17 million loss, and why he says his public results may be down around $10 million—while private gambling losses have approached $100 million. Ketola also addresses whether he believes he has a gambling problem and how he views the risks of extreme high-stakes poker.

--------
Anthony Scaramucci sits down with Vlad to revisit his post-White House break with Donald Trump, his support for Joe Biden in 2020 and Kamala Harris in 2024, and why he believes the MAGA movement has damaged America’s global reputation. The SkyBridge Capital founder also addresses Jared Kushner, Vanity Fair’s reporting, Vladimir Putin, and alleged corruption around Trump’s political circle.

The conversation then turns to FTX Ventures’ $45 million investment in SkyBridge and the collapse of Sam Bankman-Fried’s crypto empire. Scaramucci explains why he regrets accepting SBF as an investor, while stressing he did nothing wrong and cooperated with the Department of Justice, IRS, SEC, and FBI. He discusses FTX’s once-massive portfolio—including Anthropic, Solana, Robinhood, and Cursor—Bankman-Fried’s 2023 conviction, 25-year sentence, and the ongoing bankruptcy estate lawsuit involving SkyBridge’s stake.

recentItems.title: Medellin Cartel Co-founder Carlos Lehder on Being Depicted in Netflix "Narcos" Series (Part 11)
recentItems.description:
Become a VladStocks Member now: https://www.youtube.com/vladtv/join

Part 10: https://youtu.be/3HCxQhSVrfI
Part 1: https://youtu.be/AxHbPY_r1q4
--------
Carlos Lehder speaks with Vlad about Hollywood and streaming portrayals of the cocaine era, from George Jung “Boston George” and the Johnny Depp film *Blow* to Netflix’s *Narcos*. Lehder challenges parts of the popular narrative around Jung, Pablo Escobar, and the Medellín Cartel, pointing to federal court transcripts and saying he took over Jung’s California cocaine connections after they reached out to him. He also reflects on the dangers of the criminal world, describing prison, betrayal, robbery, and murder as its only “guarantees.”

The interview turns to *Narcos*, where Lehder says the show exaggerated details about him—especially depicting him with a swastika tattoo. Lehder insists he has never had tattoos, notes that swastikas are illegal in Germany, and explains his German citizenship through his father and registration at the German Embassy in Bogotá. He also mentions attorney Edward Shohat, a Jewish lawyer who defended him at trial.
